short.vo: Twenty twenty-two: a strike rate of one sixteen, the worst season of his IPL career. Twenty twenty-six: one sixty-six, the best. Is विराट कोहली too slow for modern T-twenty? We checked every ball.

panel.kicker: IS KOHLI TOO SLOW FOR T20?

short.vo: It wasn't one lucky year. One forty in twenty twenty-three. One fifty-five in twenty twenty-four. One forty-five in twenty twenty-five. And one sixty-six in twenty twenty-six.
The change starts at the start. In the powerplay, he struck at one seventeen in twenty twenty-two. In twenty twenty-six, one seventy-five.
In twenty twenty-two he hit a four or a six every seven balls. Now, every four.
Part of that is the whole league speeding up. So we measured him against it. In twenty twenty-two he was eighteen points below the league's strike rate. In twenty twenty-six, nine above.

panel.kicker: KOHLI VS THE LEAGUE'S STRIKE RATE

short.vo: One gap is left: spin. In twenty twenty-six he struck at one thirty against spin, and one seventy-eight against pace.
So is कोहली too slow for modern T-twenty? No. His slowest season came in twenty twenty-two. His fastest is the latest. Our verdict: busted.
